instruction.text: Complete the essay excerpt. Fill in the verbs below, using the past progressive.

atoms.b:
Students for the Planet

Last Friday, thousands of students gathered in the city center to demand climate action. While one student ((was_holding)) up a sign with a powerful message, others ((were_chanting)) loudly through megaphones. The streets were crowded, and traffic had to be redirected.

At the same time, a group of students from a local school ((were_performing)) a short play about environmental destruction. Many people ((were_watching)) with interest and even joined the demonstration.
While the main speaker ((was_addressing)) the crowd, journalists were taking pictures and interviewing participants. In the background, a few musicians ((were_playing)) peaceful protest songs.

Some local politicians also came by and listened while the organisers ((were_explaining)) their demands. Meanwhile, police officers ((were_making)) sure the protest remained peaceful and well-organised.
The atmosphere was calm but determined. Young people ((were_standing)) together to raise their voices for the planet. It was clear that the climate movement ((was_gaining)) momentum once again.
